scenes.basis: 8:1 "he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God's Kingdom" - the unnamed tour follows the Galilee ministry (4:44, 7:1-17)
8:22 "Let's go over to the other side of the lake"; 8:23 "as they sailed"
8:26 "They arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee"
8:40 "When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him" - the city is not named; Jairus "was a ruler of the synagogue" (8:41) of the Capernaum ministry (4:31)
